mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 0.1% signals imminent monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.1%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that triggers recessionary risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% and declines, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation increases and retail sales declines indicate stagflationary pressures that reduce real consumer purchasing power and corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and RSAFS falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly employment gain exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 100000) signals accelerating wage pressures that prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100000, or Rank IC < 0.03.
